purpose: Read one previously stored command from two fresh native processes, without resume or model turns

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('dist/personal-harness'); archived=Path('dist/releases/initial-candidate')
archived.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
if archived.exists(): raise SystemExit('archive already exists')
p.rename(archived)
PY
python3 -B scripts/package_harness.py dist/personal-harness
python3 -B scripts/package_harness.py --verify dist/personal-harness
python3 -B skills/task-harness/scripts/run_check.py --output docs/research/codex-coding-harness-implementation-evidence/python-tests-2.json --source scripts/package_harness.py --source tests/test_harness_package.py --source tests/test_run_check.py --source skills/task-harness/SKILL.md --source skills/ai-code-review/SKILL.md -- python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'"
